title: Cases Referred to Committee Against Profiteering Per Quarter Since Reconvening in March 2022
what_it_is: Cases Referred to Committee Against Profiteering Per Quarter Since Reconvening in March 2022

sections.label: GST misrepresentation complaint cases
sections.summary: 32 cases of alleged GST misrepresentation were investigated with partners; businesses stopped the practice and no repeat complaints were received.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Among these submissions, 32 cases involved specific allegations of Goods and Services Tax (GST) misrepresentation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The CAP worked with partners including the Competition and Consumer Commission of Singapore, the Consumers Association of Singapore and the People's Association to investigate these cases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The businesses concerned were cooperative and have ceased the practices of GST misrepresentation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The CAP has not received any repeat complaints of GST misrepresentation against the same shops.

sections.label: Businesses absorbing GST increase
sections.summary: Singapore has a regime for fair competition and consumer choice, and some businesses voluntarily absorbed the GST increase in 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Singapore has a robust regime in place to ensure that our businesses compete fairly and consumers have sufficient choices across the board.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: But the Government's efforts alone are not enough.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: I would also like to acknowledge businesses which voluntarily absorbed the impact of the GST increase for an initial period in 2023, such as Fairprice, Giant, Sheng Siong supermarkets as well as retailers like IKEA and Owndays.

sections.label: Handling inflation and GST feedback
sections.summary: Inflation is handled through monetary and fiscal policy, and feedback on the GST increase to 8% is monitored carefully.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: I will give a bit of a context as well the few ways in which we are handling inflation – and we have discussed this and debated this in the House multiple times: one, is monetary policy, which helps to dampen imported inflation; and the second is, as I have mentioned earlier, our fiscal policies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: I will also share that during the first GST increase to 8% that we saw earlier this year, the CAP also saw an increase in feedback volume received on this.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: So, we will monitor that very carefully and one of the key measures is also to get feedback from the ground and then we will take the appropriate measures.
